items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-05
items.q: Roy Evans was there with me on drums

ctx.x: Who is at the La Vida with you? You were talking about that.

Oh, I mentioned the fellow that was at the La Vida with me already. Such as Lee Collins, uh, John Marrero, Simon Marrero, uh, Roy Evans was there with me on drums, and Alfred William on drums, and, uh, David Jones on tennis sax, Rubichaud on piano.

items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: Raymond Doyce on the piano. Roy Evans on drums.

ctx.x: Yeah, he died here about three years ago. I think he taking Alfred's place with me at the La Vida. But after I left the La Vida, then I organized me a large band. I had the person named Hannes Louisiana Shakers. Well, I had Willie Pacho on the first trumpet. I had Rick R. Alexis on the second trumpet. I had Robert on the trombone. I had George Clark on the tenor. My cell phone alto. I had a little fella playing alto. He dropped the date up at Jackson and Germany. What was his name? I think it's his name in a…

items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: They had Joe Rubishu, Roy Evans, David Jones.

ctx.x: kind of instruments? Well no, they had a regular band there. They had Joe Rubishu, Roy Evans, David Jones. What was that band? Tenor. He was playing tenor there. I forget who was playing piano at the time. Joe Rubishu was playing piano, but I mean I forget who was playing. Bass player? No, they didn't have bass player. Trumpet? There were four pieces there. Yeah, I'm trying to think now who was playing trumpet there. I don't know, Willie Pazio. I can't remember who was playing trumpet. Kaifer. Kaifer. Who is…

Let me get back to this end of time this time. When you first went there, that was the band they had there and they weren't using it after. No. And you went there and played a little. Did you join the band or just?
